description: Page the privacy-safe contract history of a proposal-linked candidate dossier (job title, status, dates, reviewed flag — never cross-buyer compensation). Cursor-paged: pass nextCursor from the previous page; a non-null nextCursor means more pages exist, so nothing truncates silently. Requires candidate_dossier:read scope and the default-off candidate-dossier agent surface.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (nextCursor). Omit for the first page.

proposalId.description: OpenTrain proposal (job offer) id the candidate dossier is linked to.

name: opentrain_list_candidate_dossier_contract_history
